newsitem.title: USA: Stepan Co promotes two executives.
newsitem.headline: Stepan Co promotes two executives.

text.p: Stepan Co Tuesday promoted two executives, one of them to a newly created position.
Stepan named Charles Given to the new post of vice president, corporate develpment. He will be responsible for acquiring new businesses and technologies, Stepan said.

The company also promoted F. Quinn Stepan Jr. to the post of vice president and general manager, surfactants. Stepan said he succeeds Given and will have profit and loss responsibility for its North American surfactants operation.
Stepan is a specialty chemical manufacturer.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Tuesday at 19-5/8.
